name: Memory Reconsolidation Shock Test

selection.duplicate_check: Distinct from prior Proof-Carrying Adaptive State: this field tests how memory content itself should revise under surprise/conflict rather than how candidate updates prove policy compliance.

research_question: Should FRANK revise familiar visual memory by destructive online overwrite, or by a conflict-aware reconsolidation cycle that keeps the stable trace authoritative until repeated Retina evidence supports a revised trace?

mechanism_candidate.name: Conflict-Aware Memory Reconsolidation Loop (CAMRL)
mechanism_candidate.compact_law: stable memory prior + surprising Retina evidence -> CHALLENGED trace -> bounded candidate accumulation -> confirm/revise/split/rollback; never let one surprising frame destructively rewrite identity
mechanism_candidate.authority_boundary: Retina evidence remains sensor evidence; memory candidate state is prior/hypothesis. A reconsolidated trace may alter future priors but may not rewrite what the sensor actually observed.
mechanism_candidate.implementation_bias: Attempt as ordinary ClayCode typed state + events + deterministic replay before proposing any new language primitive.

hypotheses.claim: A bounded conflict-aware reconsolidation buffer can reduce corruption from isolated visual outliers while adapting quickly to repeated abrupt appearance changes.
hypotheses.falsifier: On H1 Retina<->Unified Memory traces, naive/robust online updating matches or beats corruption, adaptation latency and compute/state cost.

hypotheses.claim: The same mechanism can preserve multiple context/view variants by splitting memory state instead of overwriting a single prototype when contradictory evidence is persistent but context-separable.
hypotheses.falsifier: Context splitting increases false identity fragmentation or retrieval cost without improving UMV-E1/UMV-E4.

hypotheses.claim: GWT re-entry and conflict persistence can provide a measurable trigger for reconsolidation/active sensing without making workspace activation a truth signal.
hypotheses.falsifier: Lesioning GWT-linked conflict/re-entry triggers does not change useful reconsolidation decisions, or causes only overhead.

counterhypotheses.claim: A reconsolidation state machine may add unnecessary latency and state growth; robust streaming estimators or ordinary versioned prototypes may be sufficient.
Conservative challenge thresholds can track slow continuous drift worse than simple streaming updates.
Repeated corroborating frames can share a common failure cause, so persistence alone is not independent evidence.

synthetic_experiment.model: 1-D latent visual prototype; true state 0 then abrupt shift to 1.5 at t=500; Gaussian observation noise sd=0.25; 5% large outliers. Compare naive EWMA alpha=0.1 with CAMRL-like slow stable update plus 4-of-6 consistent surprise promotion.

countercase.model: Clean continuous latent drift 0->2 across 1000 steps; noise sd=0.1; no large outliers.
countercase.interpretation: The conservative CAMRL-like policy was ~96.6% worse in MSE on clean smooth drift, showing the mechanism needs drift-mode discrimination/adaptive thresholds rather than universal replacement of streaming updates.

synthetic_experiment.interpretation: Synthetic evidence supports a regime-dependent policy: protect stable memory against isolated shocks, but preserve a fast streaming path when drift is smooth and corroborated.
synthetic_experiment.limitations: Toy scalar dynamics, hand-chosen thresholds, no real Retina features, no Unified Memory retrieval, no project-hardware resource measurements. No FRANK performance claim may be promoted from this experiment.

cross_connections.delta: Treat Unified Memory visual identity as revisioned stable trace + candidate revisions under surprise; preserve Retina evidence separately; prefer split-context variants over destructive overwrite when persistent contradictions are context-separable.
Express CAMRL first as typed records/events/state transitions with explicit UNKNOWN/CONFLICT and replay. Do not add a new primitive unless an executable lowering/replay counterexample appears.
Use conflict persistence, re-entry and hysteresis only as measurable control signals for deeper sensing/reconsolidation; workspace ignition must not become truth authority.

Extend UMV-E2/UMV-E4/UMV-E5 with abrupt-shock vs smooth-drift regimes, lesion the reconsolidation buffer, measure false rewrites, adaptation delay, identity fragmentation, retrieval cost and active-sensing cost.
Persist stable trace, challenged candidate, context/view variant, supporting/contradicting evidence lineage and rollback ancestry without overwriting raw observation provenance.

required_next_tests: MRST-E1: replay real H1 Retina<->Unified Memory visual traces under naive robust streaming vs CAMRL vs adaptive hybrid at matched compute budget
MRST-E2: inject isolated outliers, repeated correlated bad frames, abrupt real appearance changes and smooth drift; pre-register regime labels and metrics
MRST-E3: evaluate SPLIT_CONTEXT vs overwrite on lookalikes and multi-view identity using UMV-E3/UMV-E4
MRST-E4: lesion GWT conflict/re-entry trigger and compare sensing/reconsolidation decisions to a local Retina-memory controller
MRST-E5: ClayCode roundtrip/replay test for every CAMRL state transition and crash point before any semantic change

integration_result.material_delta: Add CAMRL as a regime-dependent memory-revision candidate and preserve the smooth-drift counterexample as a mandatory falsifier.
integration_result.reason: Only toy synthetic evidence plus current project architecture constraints; no H1 executable evidence yet.
